description.value: Gwaii Naay Island House is the first Haida-owned hotel in New Masset, BC, opened in 2018 in a beautifully renovated historic Red Cross Hospital building. Owner-operator Elsie Gale, a Haida textile weaver and cultural specialist, weaves Haida language, art, and tradition into the everyday guest experience. With six rooms ranging from twin-bed shared-bath options to deluxe suites with soaker tubs, plus a separate tiny home with inlet views, it offers a genuine cultural home base for exploring Haida Gwaii's wild landscapes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail about the property. Amenities confirmed from website: laundry (mentioned multiple times, including in-unit washer/dryer for the tiny home), free WiFi throughout, shared fully equipped kitchen, guest lounge. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, drying area, pump, tools, or bike wash anywhere on the site. Nearby evening food is confirmed via explicit mention of The 626 restaurant 'right next door.' Contact details (phone, email, address) are consistently shown across multiple pages matching the OSM record.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, no OSM tags, and no address — the address, phone, and website all come from the manually-added URL and the business website itself rather than OSM data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly bookable accommodation in Masset on Haida Gwaii with a rich website confirming it is open; a clear and distinctive stop for touring cyclists exploring the islands.
enrichment_extras.notes: No bike-specific amenities are mentioned on the website. The property's cultural significance and location in Masset make it a notable inclusion for the directory regardless.

Laundry.detail: Guest laundry mentioned in shared amenities; Skun'dll Naay tiny home includes a stack washer/dryer in-unit

Nearby evening food.detail: Website explicitly states 'Right next door at The 626 some of the finest halibut is locally sourced fresh and on their extensive menu.'

Device charging.detail: Room 3 suite includes a side table with charging station; general device charging implied by free WiFi and furnished rooms
